extra.reason: Two-crate workspace (cpemu-cpu lib + cpemu bin) builds, tests, and runs on Rust 1.95 / edition 2024.

License verified redistributable (DRDOS/Sparks 2022). Authentic CCP+BDOS source vendored at third-party/cpm22/ with provenance NOTICE. Binary/origin decision deferred to boot epic per design discussion.
rustfmt + workspace clippy lints + Makefile (make check) + GitHub Actions CI. Local gate green.
All scaffolding children complete: workspace, vendored CP/M source+license, lint/CI (green).
CPU framework in place: Registers/flags/shadow, Bus trait + PlainBus, Cpu with IFF/IM/T-states/reset and observable StepResult (Normal/Halted/Illegal). NOP+HALT. 10 tests, CI gate green.
Full unprefixed opcode map implemented (x/y/z decode), Z80 flag semantics incl. undocumented Y/X, isolated ALU. 24 tests, CI green. Full validation deferred to exerciser harness yd5.6.
Initial README + dev-docs set established (architecture, cpu-core, development, roadmap). Ongoing maintenance tracked via bd memory standing instruction.

CB/ED/DD/FD all implemented with Z80 flag semantics (incl. undocumented Y/X, IXH/IXL, DDCB). step() split into fetch+execute; index handler delegates unaffected opcodes. 48 CPU tests, make check + CI green. Real validation pending exerciser harness yd5.6.
Exerciser harness done. zexdoc PASSES (v1 CPU gate met); prelim runs in CI; zexall one group short (WZ — tracked as cpemu-yd5.7).
Maskable IM 0/1/2 + NMI delivery, IFF1/IFF2, EI one-instruction shadow, unhalt-on-accept. CPU mechanism (machine drives). 8 tests, CI green.
Full Z80 disassembler (text+len), mirrors executor decode incl. all prefixes/index/DDCB. 6 tests, CI green.

CPU core COMPLETE and zexdoc-validated: full instruction set (unprefixed + CB/ED/DD/FD), interrupts (IM 0/1/2 + NMI + EI shadow), disassembler. 62 unit tests + prelim in CI; zexdoc passes in release. Child yd5.7 (WZ/MEMPTR) deferred as standalone stretch — pure undocumented flag bits, cannot affect downstream layers.
Memory (64K) with read/write/read16/write16/load/slice; cpemu now lib+bin. 4 tests, CI green.
Machine (Bus + open-bus I/O + TrapRegion) and Executor with PC-based BIOS-trap mechanism (Return/Jump/Stop), borrow-safe via 3 separate objects. Mechanism proven with dummy trap. 6 tests, CI green.
VM & memory epic complete: Memory (64K), Machine (Bus+open-bus I/O), PC-based BIOS-trap Executor (Return/Jump/Stop), MachineConfig seam with decided memory map. 13 tests, CI green.
VM & memory epic complete: Memory (64K), Machine (Bus+open-bus I/O), PC-based BIOS-trap Executor (Return/Jump/Stop), MachineConfig seam with decided memory map. 13 tests, CI green.
asl/p2bin built; genuine CCP@0xE400 (2048B) + BDOS@0xEC00 (3584B) assembled and committed; deterministic make cpm-binaries regen target verified; NOTICE documents provenance.
Disk (8in SSSD geometry, read/write sector, make_system_disk, system_area) + DPB_8INCH constant, self-consistent no-skew layout. 5 tests, CI green.

HLE BIOS complete: all 17 vectors, system-track boot (cold/warm), console + disk BIOS calls. Genuine CP/M 2.2 boots to A>; DIR->NO FILE validates the disk/BDOS data-structure chain. 20 cpemu tests, CI green.

HLE BIOS complete: all 17 vectors, system-track boot (cold/warm), console + disk BIOS calls. Genuine CP/M 2.2 boots to A>; DIR->NO FILE validates the disk/BDOS data-structure chain. 20 cpemu tests, CI green.

Interactive TerminalConsole (raw mode, reader thread, CONST/CONIN/CONOUT); cargo run boots live CP/M A>. Headless tests still green; non-TTY handled gracefully.

HLE BIOS & boot complete: all children (jump table/trap, system-track boot, console + disk BIOS calls, vendored binaries) done. Genuine CP/M 2.2 boots to interactive A>. (Epic close was missed when the children closed.)
CP/M directory + block allocation: add_file/list_files, BDOS-consistent layout. Host places HELLO.COM; CP/M DIRs it and loads+runs it off disk. 7 tests, CI green.

Fixed: BIOS jump table was empty; MBASIC reads vector JP operands to find handlers, got 0, did CALL 0 (warm boot). install() now writes JP-to-self vectors. MBASIC boots and evaluates BASIC. 2 regression tests, CI green.

ADM-3A->ANSI terminal translation (terminal.rs): ESC= cursor, ^Z/^^ clears, ESC T/Y; ESC[ passthrough; --raw opts out. Ladder/Turbo full-screen output now displays. 5 tests, CI green. Console epic complete.

ADM-3A->ANSI terminal translation (terminal.rs): ESC= cursor, ^Z/^^ clears, ESC T/Y; ESC[ passthrough; --raw opts out. Ladder/Turbo full-screen output now displays. 5 tests, CI green. Console epic complete.

8MB DiskFormat (16-bit alloc, EXM=0 via 2KB blocks) is the default drive. DPB single-sourced from format. 16-bit round-trip gate + 8MB boot/run tests pass; STAT reports 7646k free with all 27 programs loaded. 36 tests, CI green.

Broad software validation: Zork I-III, MBASIC, Turbo Pascal, ASM, Ladder, Sargon (chess), Colossal Cave Adventure, dBASE II, Multiplan all run on the emulator. Full-screen WordStar/SuperCalc need install+persistence (future). No emulator bugs found.

Ctrl-\ now raises a quit flag (AtomicBool, set by reader thread) that the run loop checks every step via Console::wants_quit() — works even when a program busy-polls CONST and never calls CONIN. Regression test added; make check green.
